atoms.a: Yazmin eats some pizza each day after school. After the first day, she has eaten <mat>3/8</mat> of a pizza. After three days, she has eaten <mat>1 1/8</mat> pizzas. She eats the same amount each day.
atoms.b: To get to the next term, ((subtract ++add)) <mat><gap>++3/8 5/8 1</gap></mat>.

atoms.a: How many pizzas has she eaten by the end of the fifth day
If she has a total of 3 pizzas at home, how long will they last before she has eaten them all.
atoms.b: Yazmin will run out of pizza after <mat><gap>8</gap></mat> days.

atoms.a: Phil is reading through a book. After one day, he has 342 pages left. After three days, he has 292. He reads the same amount of pages each day.
atoms.b: To get to the next term, ((++subtract add)) <mat><gap>20 ++25 30</gap></mat>.

atoms.a: How many pages will he have left after 6 days?
If he continues this pace, when will Phil finish his book?
atoms.b: Phil will finish his book on the <mat><gap>15</gap></mat>th day.

atoms.a: Carla is collecting cards. After the first day, she has 7 cards. after the third day, she has 21 cards. She gets the same number of cards each day.
atoms.b: To get to the next term, ((subtract ++add)) <mat><gap>++7 8 14</gap></mat>.

atoms.a: How many cards will she have after 5 days?
On which day will her collection pass 100 cards?
